name: StoreNest for WooCommerce
author: PluginNests

sections.description:
StoreNest replaces the cluttered WooCommerce admin with a Shopify-inspired staff portal — your team never needs to see the default WordPress admin again.

Whether you’re managing a retail team processing hundreds of orders a day or a small shop with a few staff members, StoreNest gives everyone a focused, fast, beautiful interface built specifically for e-commerce operations.

Features

  • Order Management — Clean order list with status filters, search, timeline notes, prev/next navigation, and inline editing
  • Bulk Actions — Update status on multiple orders or products at once
  • Product Management — Full product editor with variants, SEO fields, and stock management
  • Customer Management — Browse customers and view full order history
  • Analytics Dashboard — Revenue graphs, top products, and period-over-period comparison
  • Discounts & Coupons — View and create WooCommerce coupons without leaving the portal
  • Staff Management — Custom storenest_staff role with granular per-capability permissions
  • Dark Mode — Easy on the eyes for long shifts
  • Custom Branding — Add your logo and brand color
  • Global Search — Find orders and products from the top bar instantly
  • Shopify-like UX — Familiar card-based layouts, keyboard shortcuts, and intuitive navigation
  • Mobile Responsive — Works beautifully on tablets for warehouse or counter staff
  • HPOS Compatible — Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage

StoreNest Pro

The free version gives your team everything they need to fulfill orders beautifully. StoreNest Pro unlocks the creation tools:

  • Create Orders — Build new orders from scratch inside the portal, search existing customers or add guests, add products by name, set status, and attach a note — all without touching WooCommerce
  • Add Products — Create new simple, variable, virtual, or downloadable products with pricing, stock, and SKU directly from the portal
  • Import Products via CSV — Bulk-import products from a CSV file with preview, progress bar, and error reporting
  • Create Coupons — Generate discount codes with percent or fixed amounts, expiry dates, usage limits, and individual-use rules — including a live coupon preview card
  • Advanced Analytics — Export revenue reports to CSV, custom date ranges, and period-over-period breakdowns
  • Order Templates — Save repeat orders as templates for your team to reuse
  • Priority Support — Direct support from the StoreNest team

Upgrade to StoreNest Pro at pluginnests.com

For Shopify Migrants

Moved from Shopify to WooCommerce and missing the clean admin UI? StoreNest brings the familiar Shopify experience to your WooCommerce store. Order timelines, status pipelines, product cards — all designed to feel immediately familiar.

HPOS Compatible

StoreNest is fully compatible with WooCommerce’s High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and uses the official WooCommerce CRUD APIs throughout — no direct database queries, no compatibility headaches.

External services

This plugin optionally connects to the Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) email marketing API to subscribe site administrators to the PluginNests mailing list when they voluntarily enter their email address in an admin notice banner.

  • What data is sent: The administrator’s email address and the subscription source identifier (“storenest-plugin-banner”).
  • When it is sent: Only when the site administrator explicitly types their email and clicks the “Send Me the PDF” button in the admin banner. No data is sent automatically.
  • Service provider: Brevo (Sendinblue SAS), https://www.brevo.com
  • Terms of use: https://www.brevo.com/legal/termsofuse/
  • Privacy policy: https://www.brevo.com/legal/privacypolicy/

If the Brevo API is not configured, the email is stored locally in the WordPress database and no external request is made.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the storenest-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. You’ll find StoreNest in your WordPress admin menu — click it to open your new portal.
  4. Go to StoreNest → Staff to assign staff roles and set permissions.
  5. Staff users will be automatically redirected to StoreNest when they log in.
sections.faq:
Will StoreNest interfere with WooCommerce?

No. StoreNest only adds to WooCommerce — it never modifies WooCommerce core files or replaces any WooCommerce functionality. All data is read and written through WooCommerce’s official CRUD APIs.

Can admins still access the regular WordPress admin?

Yes. Only users with the storenest_staff role or users without manage_options capability are redirected. Administrators retain full access to both the StoreNest portal and the regular WordPress admin.

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. StoreNest declares full HPOS compatibility and uses the WooCommerce Order CRUD API exclusively.

Is it compatible with my WooCommerce plugins?

StoreNest works alongside virtually all WooCommerce plugins since it accesses data through standard WooCommerce APIs. If you encounter any incompatibilities, please open a support thread.

1.0.7

  • Fixed PHP 7.4 compatibility in license manager.

1.0.6

  • Added License page: activate your license key to auto-install and enable StoreNest Pro features.
  • Daily license validation via cron.

1.0.5

  • Fixed inline script: moved email banner JavaScript to wp_add_inline_script() for proper enqueuing.
  • Added external services disclosure for Brevo email subscription API.

1.0.4

  • Fixed admin menu position from 2 to 58 (below WooCommerce).

1.0.3

  • Fixed inline CSS: moved @keyframes animation to wp_add_inline_style().
  • Fixed REST API: restricted DELETE coupon endpoint to admin-only capability (storenest_manage_settings).

1.0.2

  • Renamed plugin to StoreNest for WooCommerce (slug: storenest-for-woocommerce).
  • Updated all internal identifiers, namespaces, and database keys to storenest_* for full naming consistency.
  • Main plugin file renamed to storenest-for-woocommerce.php.
  • Updated text domain and POT file to storenest-for-woocommerce.

1.0.1

  • Renamed plugin to StoreNest for WooCommerce.
  • All features are now fully free and unlocked — no license or trial required.
  • Removed external license validation and payment processor integration.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Order list and detail pages with Shopify-inspired UX.
  • Product list with quick-view panel.
  • Custom storenest_staff role with automatic portal redirect on login.
  • HPOS compatibility.
